--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 0. ANALYSIS OVERVIEW
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
UTHR is the lead seller of prostacyclin-based therapies for pulmonary arterial
hypertension (PAH) and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung
disease (PH-ILD). The FY2025 franchise reached $3.183B revenue, $1.335B net
income, $1.041B FCF, but FY2026 H1 revenue declined -1.8% YoY, with management
attributing this to "competitive therapies" [Actual — IR release, 2026-08-05
and 10-Q data pack]. The investment question is therefore not historical
quality (which is excellent) but whether the next set of catalyst/approvals —
Nebulized Tyvaso in IPF, ralinepag in PAH, Tyvaso DPI in IPF/PPF and
xenotransplantation — can offset patent/competitive erosion.

Engine selection: Archetype B (Quality Compounder) with mandatory Engine-4
optionality overlay because future value is heavily dependent on pipeline
approvals after 2027. A stage-scenario DCF is used (Engine 1 + Engine 4 logic)
rather than a single multiple DCF. Output discipline requires probabilities,
conservative net-cash treatment and a Red Team section; all present below.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 1. MACRO CONTEXT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

therefore labelled [Assumption]/[Estimate] and not intended as macro forecasts):

Step 1-4 Macro alignment: weighted by regime distribution → mild net tailwind
(biotech liquidity + zero debt). Position sizing only; no change to intrinsic
value. Regime-contingent base case: if recession probability exceeds 35%,
growth-stock duration premium compresses, drug-spending insurance risk rises

SECTION 1.5. BASE RATE & HISTORICAL PATTERN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Step 1.5-1 Similar-company base rates (with data-pack / industry anchors).

1. Specialty pharma with mature marketed product surviving the next 5 years:

4. Platform/technology paradigm (xenotransplantation) achieving commercial

5. BLEND for Engine-4-type statement = probability-weighted sum

kept at 25-30% after re-evaluation. New launch base rate in pulmonary/PH has

disease launches outside PAH), so the moderation is justified.

(1) UTHR sells prescription prostacyclins (Tyvaso DPI, Nebulized Tyvaso,
Remodulin, Orenitram, plus Unituxin oncology) through a specialty sales force
to PAH/PH-ILD clinics. (2) The same treprostinil molecule is delivered in
several device/formulation formats, creating shared chemistry but differentiated
delivery economics. (3) Future growth is meant to come from expanding the
treprostinil franchise into IPF/PPF (via regulatory approval of Nebulized Tyvaso
and Tyvaso DPI in IPF/PPF), adding the oral prostacyclin ralinepag, and a
high-risk organ/xenotransplantation platform. Understandability: High.

- Network effects: 0
